I can make your parents hurt themselves. I can make them hurt each other. I can make them eat each other if I want to. Do I want to, Alex? Do you believe me? Promise you will not talk about me to another human being, say it. „ ~ Gladys threatening Alex with harming his parents Aunt Gladys is the main antagonist of the 2025 supernatural mystery horror film Weapons. She is a parasitic witch who claims to be a relative of the Lilly family and is the one who is responsible for the disappearance of the seventeen missing children from Maybrook Elementary School. She was portrayed by Amy Madigan, who won an Academy Award for her role. What Makes Her Pure Evil?[] Integrating herself into the Lilly family, she brainwashed Alex’s parents and rendered them catatonic as she feeds off their energy. She neglects Alex as she forces him to take care of his parents and feeding them himself. In order to keep him quiet, he has the brainwashed parents stab at themselves while threatening to have them kill each other in order to make Alex agree to stay quiet. She has Alex take the drawings of his classroom of 17 other students and proceeds to brainwash them all, sending them out of their house in the middle of the night and keeping them in her basement for a month, feeding off their energy as they are rendered catatonic and cared for by a traumatized Alex. This results in dozens of families experiencing grief, as they lost their children and the witch hunt to Justine as they believe her to have a role in the children’s disappearance. Haunts Justine and Archer in their dreams for trying to personally investigate for themselves what happened to the seventeen missing children. When James breaks into the house trying to steal some items, he discovers the kids in the basement and attempts to contact the police for the reward money, and she proceeds to haunt him in the forest and ultimately brainwashes both him and Paul once they return to the house. When Marcus planned to call CPS at the behest of Justine, Gladys brainwashed Marcus and forces him to brutally bash his husband’s skull in before sending him to murder Justine, the attempted murder causing Marcus' head to swell badly and later to die when he is hit by a car with his dead horrificaly exploding. This also traumatized the woman who accidentaly hit and killed him. Feeling the heat on her, she packs up and plans to skip town with her brainwashed victims to continue feeding their energy and continue her scheme. While she is planning to keep Alex around, this is purely to keep him as a servant and shows no care when the brainwashed parents attempt to murder him. When Justine and Archer break into the house, she sends the brainwashed Paul and James to attack them, forcing the two to kill the brainwashed attackers. While Aunt did warn Alex not to pass the salt so he doesn't get killed by his brainwashed parents, this is out of pragmatic reasoning since she needs Alex to help her with her plans. She manages to brainwash Archer and have him strangle Justine to try and murder her, sadistically watching and having it be slow as possible. While her death at the hands of alex and also indirectly brainwashed children was a gruesome sight to behold, it is played for satisfaction due to all of her crimes. Although the scene is also somewhat darkly comedic, with her pathetically running away screaming in panic as she gets chased down by the children, it does not detract from her villany either as it's portrayed as a karmic punishment for her. Furthermore, during the chase sequence, Gladys breaks into several houses as the rabid children run after her, causing a lot of collateral damage, which further goes to show that, even in her final moments, she still didn't care about endangering the lives of innocent people at all. Even after she was killed by Alex Lilly and the brainwashing was lifted, her actions still have a profound effect as Alex's parents are rendered catatonic and institutionalized, and Alex himself is heavily traumatized by everything that happened. Furthermore, the 17 freed children are also rendered mute and unable to speak for years and are traumatized by what they went through. Granted, it was stated in-universe that her effect on the children was beginning to fade, since they were willing to talk again. However, this doesn't evade the fact that her magic, manipulation, and psychological abuse caused severe damage to everyone involved.
